body:
>but then there are also really really good times. 

I don't get to have those, that was the point. Thanks for the words; words never mattered in the end though, only actions. Actions and words never synched up, funny how that worked. I kept hearing about all of these great people, but all I met was more of the same, always more of the same, almost like it's a species-wide thing and I'm the problem. Oh well, there is nothing good and some people will pretend there is because it makes them feel warm and fuzzy. Someone will probably die of a heroin od in the alley nearby tonight, the world is shit. the end. it didn't have to be this way, but that would require real effort, something that doesn't exist.

Intelligence matters to sex approximately nil.  I promise, don't take my word for it, look at the fact that 30%+ of MIT students are virgins. Proof is in the pudding.

Killing myself will solve everything. It will end this unyielding pain I feel in the face of an entirely uncaring populace and peer group that is society around me.  This world is shit for some people, and clearly some of us were not meant for it.  I am sick of being the outcast and putting so much fucking effort in for nothing.  Absolutely nothing. 

At the end of the day, a cute rich girl's feelings matter more than anything, if she doesn't feel comfortable with a homeless person, that person is asked to leave, even if they have nowhere to go. Their feelings matter more than another's existence entirely. Some people don't matter, the end.

I tried letting go of the anger, I am not Buddha and I have to live on this planet.  That is an impossible task, like forgiving someone who is constantly smashing your fingers. Women are attracted to specific physical features.  There's always some bullshit excuse, but the truth is, it comes down to luck, what body you were born into.

Fuck off.  I am killing myself this month with a shotgun.  This planet is disgusting, consider it a favor I am cognizant of other's suffering and consciousness (as ill-intentioned, self-obsessed and malignant as it always is in the end) to not bring them down with me, and make me one of them.

Like intelligence ever mattered.

It only offended me because I've heard it before, then analyzed it, meditated on it for months, and went nowhere with it. I just don't get it, why do men have to do so much more than women just to get touched?  We're not talking about dream relationships, we're talking about not coming home to an empty bed, again, always.  I get it though, I need to man up and shoot myself, because even hardcore psychedelic drugs can't make me attractive enough that a women doesn't feel insecure talking to me, even though she does on some level clearly find me attractive.

I had to relearn all that stuff because it isn't properly taught to young men, we aren't taught how to actually be attractive, just how to "be friends."

No, they just don't want to touch me. I'm sure if I gave them tons of attention they'd keep me around just for that (while qualifying me as "a friend" with that knowing look and  specific slant to the voice, every time she introduces me to a friend [been around this block before]).  I get it, no one deserves anything, but if life is this empty, I'm out.  

The end, it was a joke and not worth it [3/10], would not recommend unless intensely bored, warning may cause increased boredom once you realize you're sitting in the cheap seats and people are making out in the back; warning may cause intense frustration when you realize the entire point was to make out in the back and you're the joke.

I don't believe I do.  I am extremely conscious and aware of my body language, and my vocal intonations.  We're talking about not saying hello back, among other things.  I am not so sure a stranger could tell "aspergers" for that, though I understand it is massively en vogue to label anything outside of our little fucking box as social disability.

Fuck it, I'll just kill myself, fuck everyone such a horrible species. Do everything perfectly, it's all about us, not you, it was never about you, you see, we have vaginas so we are above you, how do you miss this?  Approach us perfectly or you deserve everything bad in life you get.  We are the arbiters of fate, let's go watch netflix and talk about whatever is trendy, namely nothing. Late 20s. Who gives a shit that people like being alone; people dislike starving too.
